title: Hunts FH-030S: Author count rules and chapters, and feed live venue closures to the engine

source.ref: Split from FH-030 (2026-11-16): the pure count rules, validation, evaluation and the read path shipped dark; authoring and live closure state move here.

detail: Requires FH-030, FH-029. The engine (lib/hunts/graph/count-rules.ts) evaluates N-of-M groups, venue buckets, equivalent placements and regional chapters, but nothing can author them: publishRows in lib/hunts/draft.ts writes ALL groups only and no screen writes hunt_mission_placements.venue_space_id or hunt_versions.policy.chapters. Build the authoring surface through a lib/studio entity (a threshold per group, a venue per placement, a substitute placement, chapters with an on and off control), run validateGraph on the result before publish and before a placement binding is added to a live version, and pass live closures (a revoked placement, a withdrawn or suspended partner Space) as closed placements into that publish guard and into the player evaluation in lib/hunts/run-store.ts. Word the new blockers and a closed stop for the player per docs/NAMING.md. Done when: a resident-built Passport with a 3 of 5 threshold publishes, a planned closure that breaks a chapter is refused before it goes live, and a player sees a closed stop as closed. Owner role: Game systems. Hunts switches stay OFF.
